# B-Webs

> B-Webs is a web development company based in Thrissur, Kerala, India, building modern, fast, mobile-friendly websites for businesses, schools, communities and online stores across India.

B-Webs designs and develops custom websites — business websites, portfolio websites, e-commerce stores, and fully custom platforms — along with local SEO, Google Business Profile management, and Google Search Console management.

## Services

- [Website Design & Development](https://www.b-webs.com/best-web-design-india): Custom website design and development for Indian businesses, including business websites, portfolios, and e-commerce stores.
- [Local SEO](https://www.b-webs.com/local-seo-services-india): On-page and technical SEO to help a website become easier for search engines to understand.
- [Google Business Profile Management](https://www.b-webs.com/bussiness-profile-services-india): Setup, optimization, and ongoing management of a business's Google Business Profile.
- [Google Search Console Management](https://www.b-webs.com/search-console-managment-india): Setup, sitemap submission, indexing requests, and search performance monitoring.
- [Web Development in Kerala](https://www.b-webs.com/web-development-kerala): Website development for businesses based in Thrissur and across Kerala.
- [Web Development in India](https://www.b-webs.com/web-development-service-india): Website development for businesses across India.
- [All Services](https://www.b-webs.com/services): Full overview of every service B-Webs offers.
